stations.title: Elspeth
stations.say: Can it load the day they pick?

stations.title: Timetable files
stations.text: One file per day, saved after the rota.

captions: By the ticket window, Elspeth wants the ride board to load whichever day a visitor picks.
A visitor picks Saturday, and the board stays blank: nothing asks for the day's file.
You ask for the day from an effect and handle every answer, in four tasks.
Saturday's rides arrive and show, with a loading line while they are on their way.
Same files, now a board that asks. A missing day gets a polite word, not a blank.
